mentions.name: PaperRight
mentions.description: A simple 50/30/20 budgeting app built on manual expense entry. It avoids automated and AI-based tracking because the builder found those lead to disengagement, while manual tracking helps users actually understand their finances.
mentions.problem: AI/automated budget trackers led to ignoring finances; manual entry is needed to genuinely understand and manage one's finances.
